# Two-week collection schedule template

**Blank shared template.** Copy it to an ignored private location before entering availability,
contact details or attendance. No slots are assigned by this file. Refer to the

## Fixed requirements

- Five students; five weekly sessions repeated in the same slots for two consecutive weeks.
- Retain approximately two hours per student per week and the two-week second round unless
  amended by the lab. Overall collection must finish by **30 November 2026**. The earlier
  15 October Batch 1 milestone is historical, with completion unverified.
- Reconcile individual first-round counts against the 500 target and finish any shortfall on
  the same set before moving on. C01 Session A/B are within Round 1, not the two rounds.
- Ask about availability around **5 pm** where feasible; this is optional if difficult.
- One consolidated schedule email to Dr. Divya. Send actual proposed availability promptly;
  confirm lab slots and protocol before scanning. C01/F06 set the first-round target at 500;
  second-round quota/scope and QC acceptance remain to be confirmed.
